title: Upcoming Selling Plans Store Fee in Northloop Payments Card Settlements
content:
A store plan fee about to be billed under Selling Plans is included in a seller-authorised card settlement of a negative Northloop Payments balance.

**Rule.** The upcoming store fee is the monthly term fee of the seller's store plan when the plan is billed on the monthly term and its next billing date falls on the settlement date or no more than 7 calendar days after it; it is the annual term monthly fee when the plan is billed on the annual term and its next billing date falls on the settlement date or no more than 7 calendar days after it; otherwise it is nothing. It is added unchanged to the settlement basis as topped up, and the card settlement amount so obtained is rounded to the cent.

The billing term, the next billing date and the term fees are those of the seller's store plan on the Selling Plans record.

## Ladder

| Billing term of the store plan | Next billing date | Upcoming store fee |
|---|---|---|
| monthly | on the settlement date or 1 to 7 calendar days after it | the plan's monthly term fee |
| annual | on the settlement date or 1 to 7 calendar days after it | the plan's annual term monthly fee |
| either | before the settlement date, or more than 7 calendar days after it | nothing |
| no store plan billing date | — | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, settlement date S)

| Next billing date | Upcoming store fee included |
|---|---|
| S | yes |
| S plus 7 | yes |
| S plus 8 | no |
| S less 1 | no |
